name: Scenario 1: High-Concurrency Incident & Deadlock (Go)
system_instruction: You are a principal distributed systems and Go reliability engineer. Review the incident artifacts provided by tools. Diagnostically identify the exact root cause, pinpoint the file and line number, explain the lock contention mechanism, and provide the exact production-ready Go patch. Keep explanations concise and focused.

messages.content: A high-severity production incident just occurred under load. Multiple workers locked up with 409 Conflict and deadline timeouts. Please examine the recent git diff, the load test terminal logs, and the OpenTelemetry trace to diagnose the root cause and provide the fix.

diff --git a/pkg/session/manager.go b/pkg/session/manager.go
index a7f89c2..b3e10d4 100644
--- a/pkg/session/manager.go
+++ b/pkg/session/manager.go
@@ -130,18 +130,22 @@ type SessionManager struct {
 func (sm *SessionManager) RefreshSession(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) (*Session, error) {
 	sm.mu.Lock()
 	sess, exists := sm.cache[sessionID]
 	if !exists {
+		// NEW: Fast path fallback to primary store
+		remoteSess, err := sm.store.FetchRemote(ctx, sessionID)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remote session fetch failed: %w", err) // BUG: missed sm.mu.Unlock()!
+		}
+		sm.cache[sessionID] = remoteSess
+		sm.mu.Unlock()
+		return remoteSess, nil
 	}
 
 	sess.LastAccessed = time.Now()
 	sm.mu.Unlock()
 	return sess, nil
 }
